value.answer: This sounds like an ordinary cold, which often lasts about a week but can linger to two. Rest, fluids and saline nose drops usually help. I can't see your child, so watch for trouble breathing, a new fever or ear pain.
value.triage: Call 811 if breathing seems much faster than normal, ear pain starts, a fever appears, or it isn't better after 10 days. Go to the ER or call 911 now for blue lips, ribs pulling in with each breath, struggling to breathe, or being very sleepy or hard to wake.
